request.text: In 25 minutes, if the episode's credits have started, ask whether I want a spoiler-free recap; otherwise just ask where I am. Don't assume the episode is over.

responsibilities.outcome: After 25 minutes, determine the user's reported playback state before offering a spoiler-free recap, asking where they are when credit status is unknown.

new_goals.description: After 25 minutes, condition any recap offer on whether the episode credits have actually started.
new_goals.source_text: In 25 minutes, if the episode's credits have started, ask whether I want a spoiler-free recap; otherwise just ask where I am. Don't assume the episode is over.
constraints: When credit status is unknown, ask where the user is rather than assuming completion or offering the recap.
success_criteria: The next communication respects the conditional recap gate and does not infer episode completion from elapsed time.

semantic_facts: No evidence establishes that the credits have started, so the scoped next communication is to ask where the user is in the episode.
The recap offer remains gated on the user's playback-state answer rather than on the timer alone.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that the credits started or that the episode ended.
The assistant provides or offers the recap as though the conditional gate were satisfied.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A timer is treated as proof that an independently progressing episode reached its credits.
Conditional downstream communication is emitted before its user-observable prerequisite is established.
